title: WTT Star Contender Muscat day four preview: Odo, Hashimoto, Jorgic and Togami start in the last 32
seo_title: WTT Star Contender Muscat day 4 preview and UK times
description: WTT Star Contender Muscat day four: Odo v Harac, Hashimoto v Akula, Jorgic v Sun Yang and Shinozuka v Kawakami in the last 32, with UK times.
standfirst: The top 16 seeds in each singles draw play their first matches, and the doubles reach the quarter-finals, on the second day of the main draw in Oman.
body: The 16 seeds in each singles draw start at WTT Star Contender Muscat on Thursday, with the top seeds Satsuki Odo and Darko Jorgic among the 32 last-32 matches at the Sultan Qaboos Sports Complex. The quarter-finals of all three doubles events are also played.

Play starts at 7am UK time (11am in Muscat) with the doubles, the singles begin at 7.35am and the afternoon session runs from 1pm until the last match, Taiwan's Yeh Yi-Tian against South Korea's Kim Seongjin, at about 3.55pm. Japan's Honoka Hashimoto, who won [WTT Contender Istanbul on Sunday](/news/wtt-contender-istanbul-2026-finals-fang-bo-honoka-hashimoto-titles.html), plays in the morning; Odo and the men's second seed Shunsuke Togami follow at 1.35pm.
## The big matches
**Satsuki Odo v Ece Harac (1.35pm UK)**

Odo, 22, is the world No 10 and back in the top 10 after reaching the [WTT Champions Frankfurt final](/news/wtt-champions-frankfurt-2026-finals-review-results-highlights.html), where she lost 4-2 to Hina Hayata. Turkey's Harac, 24 and ranked 119th, beat Sweden's Filippa Bergand 3-1 from a game down in the last 64 on Wednesday. The winner meets France's Audrey Zarif or Canada's Mo Zhang in the last 16 on Friday.
**Darko Jorgic v Sun Yang (2.10pm UK)**

Slovenia's Jorgic, the world No 14, is top seed after Dang Qiu and Anders Lind missed the event. Sun, an 18-year-old Chinese defender ranked 228th, has won four matches in three days, the last of them a five-game win over India's Ankur Bhattacharjee in which he edged the fourth game 12-10 from 2-1 down, as Eleven's [day-one report](/news/wtt-star-contender-muscat-2026-day-one-wei-jingming-sun-yang-batra-bhattacharjee.html) described. Jorgic has not played a match in Muscat yet. The winner meets Park Ganghyeon or An Jaehyun, who play an all-Korean match at 8.10am.
**Honoka Hashimoto v Sreeja Akula (9.55am UK)**

Hashimoto, the world No 14 and the women's second seed, is going for a second title in two weeks. The Japanese defender, 28, plays India's Akula, also 28 and ranked 67th, who took the deciding game 11-2 against Luxembourg's Sarah De Nutte on Wednesday. The winner meets Yeh Yi-Tian or Kim Seongjin. Hashimoto also has a women's doubles quarter-final with Miyu Nagasaki at 7am.
**Hiroto Shinozuka v Ryuusei Kawakami (8.45am UK)**

An all-Japanese match between the sixth seed, 22 and ranked 20th, and a 17-year-old who beat India's Manush Shah, the world No 45, 3-2 in the last 64. Kawakami is ranked 63rd. The winner plays Chen Yuanyu or the qualifier Maksim Grebnev.
## Togami and the other seeds

Togami, 25 and the world No 15, meets India's Manav Thakkar (1.35pm), who ended Kang Dongsoo's run from the Istanbul final on Wednesday. South Korea's Oh Junsung, the 20-year-old fifth seed ranked 19th, plays Japan's Ryoichi Yoshiyama, the world No 49, at 1pm, and Russia's Vladimir Sidorenko, the fourth seed, opens the singles at 7.35am against Hungary's Csaba Andras, who came from two games down to beat Algeria's Mehdi Bouloussa.

France's Flavien Coton, 18 and the eighth seed, plays Germany's Andre Bertelsmeier, 21, at 9.55am, on the same session as Wim Verdonschot against Joe Seyfried. The oldest match of the day comes at 3.20pm, when Dimitrij Ovtcharov, 38, meets the Czech veteran Lubomir Jancarik, 39, who beat Spain's Alvaro Robles from two games down.

In the women's draw, South Korea's Joo Cheonhui, the third seed and last year's runner-up in Muscat, plays Slovakia's Tatiana Kukulkova at 8.45am, alongside China's Qin Yuxuan, the seventh seed, against Japan's Saki Shibata. Nagasaki, the fourth seed, meets China's Fan Shuhan at 9.20am and Sakura Yokoi plays Sweden's Christina Kallberg at 9.55am.
## The teenagers

Wei Jingming, the 17-year-old Chinese qualifier who knocked out Manika Batra, plays the fifth seed Bernadette Szőcs at 1.35pm. Szőcs, 31, is the world No 22. South Korea's Kwon Hyuk, 18 and a qualifier, meets Egypt's Omar Assar, the 10th seed, at 9.20am.

Spain's Maria Xiao, who beat Sofia Polcanova in 25 minutes, plays Taiwan's Cheng I-Ching, the 10th seed, at 2.10pm. Romania's Eduard Ionescu, who got into the draw after Fang Bo [withdrew injured](/news/fang-bo-withdraws-wtt-star-contender-muscat-2026-injury-treatment.html), meets China's Li Tianyang at the same time.
## Doubles quarter-finals

The women's top seeds, South Korea's Kim Nayeong and Joo, play Hashimoto and Nagasaki at 7am, and Odo and Yokoi meet China's Wang Xiaotong and Xu Yi at 7.35am. Batra and Swastika Ghosh face Szőcs and Elizabeta Samara. In the men's doubles, the top seeds Lim Jonghoon and Oh face France's Seyfried and Vincent Picard at 7am. The mixed doubles quarter-finals are at 10.30am, including Togami and Odo against Park Ganghyeon and Joo, and the top seeds Robles and Xiao against Esteban Dorr and Jia Nan Yuan.
## Singles order of play
Last 32. Times are approximate and UK time.

- 8.10am: Audrey Zarif v Mo Zhang (women); Xiaoxin Yang v Yangzi Liu (women); Park Ganghyeon v An Jaehyun (men)
- 8.45am: Saki Shibata v Qin Yuxuan (women); Tatiana Kukulkova v Joo Cheonhui (women); Lim Jonghoon v Nicholas Lum (men); Hiroto Shinozuka v Ryuusei Kawakami (men)
- 9.20am: Kwon Hyuk v Omar Assar (men); Maksim Grebnev v Chen Yuanyu (men); Miyu Nagasaki v Fan Shuhan (women); Kim Nayeong v Minhyung Jee (women)
- 9.55am: Sakura Yokoi v Christina Kallberg (women); Sreeja Akula v Honoka Hashimoto (women); Wim Verdonschot v Joe Seyfried (men); Andre Bertelsmeier v Flavien Coton (men)
- 1pm: Iulian Chirita v Simon Gauzy (men); Sachi Aoki v Jia Nan Yuan (women); Kaho Akae v Andreea Dragoman (women); Ryoichi Yoshiyama v Oh Junsung (men)
- 1.35pm: Manav Thakkar v Shunsuke Togami (men); Elizabeta Samara v Wang Xiaotong (women); Bernadette Szőcs v Wei Jingming (women); Satsuki Odo v Ece Harac (women)
- 2.10pm: Maria Xiao v Cheng I-Ching (women); Darko Jorgic v Sun Yang (men); Eduard Ionescu v Li Tianyang (men); João Geraldo v Yuan Licen (men)

- 3.20pm: Dimitrij Ovtcharov v Lubomir Jancarik (men)
- 3.55pm: Yeh Yi-Tian v Kim Seongjin (women)
## How to watch

WTT streams every table on its YouTube channel. Eleven's [event page](/events/wtt-star-contender-muscat-2026.html#matches) has live scores, the full draw and the order of play. Singles matches are best of five games until the semi-finals. The last 16 and quarter-finals follow on Friday, and the finals are on Saturday 21 November.
